sources.title: GitHub - peonist-ai/halogen-flash-server: The fastest way to run Qwen3 ...
sources.snippet: halogen™ is the fastest way to run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on AMD Strix Halo, and it does not get there by spending fewer bits. Every kernel is written for this one GPU and this one model family. No general-purpose runtime, no portability layer, no fallback path. That is why it can do things a general engine cannot, and why it runs on exactly one piece of silicon.
